title: Payment Funding Source
description: A credential type that directly represents an underlying real-world payment instrument (e.g., a card, a bank account). Funding sources are a subset of credentials. Wrapping credentials such as provider tokens are NOT funding sources — they convey a funding source rather than being one. Concrete funding-source credential schemas (e.g., `card_fpan_credential.json`) inherit from this schema; consumers can identify funding-source credential types by checking that ancestry rather than via an out-of-band annotation.
